profile.name: Danielle Brooks
profile.summary: HR business partner with 6 years supporting hourly store teams in multi-unit retail and quick-service restaurants. Known for calm, well-documented employee relations work and practical manager coaching.

descriptions: Partner with 4 district managers and 38 general managers across 52 cafés in New England
Lead employee relations cases and workplace investigations from intake to resolution, closing 140+ cases a year with documented findings
Coach GMs and shift leads on performance management, feedback and difficult conversations
Rebuilt the new-hire onboarding journey in UKG, cutting 90-day turnover from 41% to 29%
Run quarterly engagement surveys and action planning for 1,900 employees
Built people data dashboards in Google Sheets for attendance, turnover and staffing across all 52 cafés
Rolled out updated attendance and meal-break policies to stay compliant with Massachusetts labor law
Partner with Talent Acquisition on hiring plans and interview calibration for seasonal peaks
Supported store managers in 11 retail locations with staffing and scheduling
Administered the Greenhouse ATS for hourly hiring
